page.notes: Marginal notes: none visible. Line "Hu mæg se man pel papan..." is Old English in Anglo-Saxon script, transcribed as best possible; uncertain. Lines in "Quomodo illi" passage and "Deum atque" uncertain. Left-hand damaged tear at top-left and stains; no reliable readings lost.
